costRevenueImpactInformation.costRevenueImpactShortDescription: Cost of DATSs (maintenance + annual fees)
Initial investment for the DATSs
Cost of fuel: The DATS can help optimize field operations. However, the observed average fuel use is higher in the parcels with DATS

Cost of pesticides : The support of the DSS can certainly optimize the crop protection strategy in terms of quantity and type of products but also in terms of timing and number of applications per season. However, the average cost for pesticides increases in the parcels with DATSs
Cost of fertilizers: The DSS provides recommendations on the amount of nutrients needed and optimal timing for application

Cost of labour for irrigation: An optimization of field practices and a reduction in required working hours are observed, although the absolute difference in cost (€ per hectare) remains limited for this type of crop
Revenues: The increase in revenues derives from higher yields achieved with the DATS and the better agronomical management supported by the DATS
Net Benefit: Thanks mainly to cost reduction, the Cost-Benefit Analysis shows a positive net benefit
